source: Van Wagner & Pickett (1985) FWI System calibration sample, distributed by the Natural Resources Canada cffdrs R package and its cffdrs_py port
subset_description: The 48-day calibration sample (1985-04-13 through 1985-05-30, latitude 40 N) with full-precision daily FFMC, DMC, DC, ISI, BUI, FWI, and DSR generated by cffdrs_py commit 0f57fcca2a6a84b69fe8d50f29d947f0be34d5f6. Weather inputs are the noon observations carried in that repository's fwi_test_data.csv, in its own units: temperature in degrees Celsius, relative humidity in percent, 10 m wind speed in km/h, and 24 h precipitation in mm.
citation: Van Wagner, C.E. and Pickett, T.L. (1985) Equations and FORTRAN program for the Canadian Forest Fire Weather Index System. Canadian Forestry Service, Forest Technical Report 33, 18 pp. https://cfs.nrcan.gc.ca/pubwarehouse/pdfs/19973.pdf (moved to https://ostrnrcan-dostrncan.canada.ca/handle/1845/228362). Reference values generated with cffdrs_py commit 0f57fcca2a6a84b69fe8d50f29d947f0be34d5f6, the Python port of the Natural Resources Canada cffdrs R package.
license: The weather record is a Government of Canada publication (Forest Technical Report 33) redistributed by the GPL-2.0 cffdrs R package and its cffdrs_py port; no source code is redistributed here and the derived index values are numerical outputs committed with attribution. The underlying 1985 report remains Crown copyright; only non-copyrightable numeric facts and program outputs are committed.
notes: Reference columns are the daily CFFWIS recurrence driven one day at a time through cffdrs_py's fine_fuel_moisture_code, duff_moisture_code, drought_code, initial_spread_index, buildup_index, and fire_weather_index with the literature seeds FFMC=85, DMC=6, DC=15, latitude 40, and the record's calendar month; DSR is the analytic 0.0272 * FWI**1.77 transform. The record's published one-decimal values agree with these full-precision outputs within the published rounding bound (measured maximum absolute deviation 0.0497; DSR 0.0047).
